text:
Nina: Quiet window starts in 30m. quick preflight — list any blockers now. :hourglass:
Omar: SRE green. smoke scripts uploaded, drain hooks ready. No infra changes allowed except emergency patches with rollback plan.
Product: UX sign-off received. confirm no experiments or feature flag flips.
DevBot: Canary created: canary-9002 -> backend:v2026-03-22-rc. status: warming (2 pods).
SRE: Canary health targets: p95 < 260ms, errors < 0.4%. baseline captured.
Nina: Owners: canary watch Omar/SRE, traffic ops Nina/Omar, rollback lead Omar. Pager routed.
Pager: Escalation chain set: Pager -> oncall -> eng-lead. thresholds pushed.
Omar: Rollback triggers (agreed):
- sustained errors > 0.6% for 4m OR
- p95 latency +35% over baseline for 5m OR
- Product confirms regression in critical flow.
Nina: Rollback action: unpin and revert to v2026-03-21 and open fastrollback ticket.
Omar: Quick rollback commands:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/backend --namespace=prod --to-revision=4
devbot revert canary-9002 --to v2026-03-21
```
SRE: Canary ramp: 0% -> 5% (8m) -> 25% (20m) -> 70% (25m) -> 100% (7m). 10m hold between ramps.
Product: We'll validate user flows during the 25% hold and sign off for next step.
Nina: Config knobs for window: quantization=off, batch-mode=conservative, cache-ttl=45s for first 40m.
DevBot: Preflight checks: lint=pass, infra-health=pass, smoke=pass.
Omar: Running smoke logs show "worker warmup 2/3" — watching for completion within 6m.
Nina: If warmup not 3/3 in 6m, call abort. Omar to call abort here.
Omar: Roger — I'll post abort if needed.
Nina: Last call: any objections to starting ramp at T-minus 20m?
Product: No objections.
Pager: Alerts set for error-rate-3m, latency-p95-10m, auth-errors. runbooks linked.
Nina: GO in 10. post single-line GO to start.
Omar: GO
DevBot: Canary ramp started -> 5% traffic.
Nina: Monitoring dashboards now. tagging @Product @Omar for visibility.
